query:
UPDATE products SET
                sku = ?2,
                barcode = ?3,
                name = ?4,
                description = ?5,
                price_cents = ?6,
                cost_cents = ?7,
                tax_rate_bps = ?8,
                track_inventory = ?9,
                allow_negative_stock = ?10,
                current_stock = ?11,
                is_active = ?12,
                updated_at = ?13,
                sync_version = sync_version + 1
            WHERE id = ?1
